changes: FramedEndpoint error_response callback replaces device-specific PRCXI error dictionary; default closes invalid request without reply
tty imported only on PTY construction; TCP import has no POSIX dependency
limitations: TCP loopback only; PTY POSIX only, owns newly created pseudoterminal
one start/close lifecycle; no restart/epoch/barrier or callback rollback

PTY byte error replies retain original ERR framing; device content remains in callbacks
original facility consumer will switch separately; no production service change
